reference.scope: Documented Tinycast macOS behavior; independent implementation; not universal Store compatibility

source.basis: Current API and selected child read completely; manager/install/storage relevant flows traced. This is a conservative finite group ledger with exact measured deltas, not per-member or final installed acceptance. Untouched historical evidence stays limited to its recorded checkpoint.

verifiedDeltas.behavior: Import-time immutable extensionName/entryPointName/entryPointType/entryPointMode and deprecated commandName/commandMode for view, no-view and menu-bar; invalid provider preserves prior state.

verifiedDeltas.behavior: SDK LaunchType strings, immutable environment.launchType and matching root launch props in all three manual modes; absent optional context/draft/fallback is not invented; malformed or missing metadata fails explicitly.

verifiedDeltas.doctor: Two complete isolated scans; same five pre-existing semantic candidates, +2 source-line shift, no score
verifiedDeltas.limit: No background scheduler, argument entry, context, complete environment, native-effect, Desktop or installed compatibility acceptance.
